title: 第21章 联合而来第22章 天阴老人的强势
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
说罢，他转过头去看向后山，口中高声喊道：“几位都出来吧！莫要让天阴老祖误以为我等尚未准备妥当！”
其声如洪钟，在山间回荡。
话音未落，只见三道身影从后山急速飞驰而来。
眨眼之间，那三道身影便已稳稳地落在了周家老祖的不远处。
待三人落稳，赫然便是袁家老祖、黄家老祖以及莫家老祖。
周家老祖见状，嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹不易察觉的笑容。
他稍稍停顿了一下，然后继续将目光投向天阴老人，缓声道：“天阴老祖，这三位便是我们北源河畔的另外三大家族的老祖了。
他们得知你今日大驾光临，特在此恭候多时了！”
天阴老人闻言，面无表情地点了点头，算是回应了周家老祖的介绍。
然而，就在此时，站在天阴老人身旁的王家老祖看向众人开口说道：“老夫横水王家王氿永，今日有幸得见三位，实乃三生有幸啊！”
说罢，他还特意对着那三家老祖拱手作揖，脸上露出了和善的笑容。
莫家老祖见状，赶忙回礼道：“在下莫家莫应声，久闻王老祖大名，今日一见，果然名不虚传！”
紧接着，黄家老祖也拱手笑道：“黄家黄霸虎，见过王老祖！”
最后，袁家老祖也不甘示弱，朗声道：“袁家袁崇仁，拜见王老祖！”
接着几人又是一番客套。
而在一旁的天阴老人，面色依旧阴沉，用冰冷冰冷的声音说道。
“既然都准备好了，那便出发吧！”他的话语简短而直接，没有丝毫拖泥带水。
然而，这简单的一句话，却透露出一种无法忽视的威严和冷漠。
对于所谓的北源河畔四大家族，天阴老人显然根本没有将他们放在眼里。
在场的众人，除了王家老祖面色如常，似乎对天阴老人的态度并不在意之外。

其他四大家族的老祖们相互对视一眼，都能从彼此的眼中看到一丝不悦。
毕竟，他们也是先天圆满境界的强者，但在天阴老人面前，却完全感受不到应有的尊重。
这种被人轻视的感觉，让这四位老祖的心中都有些不是滋味。
不过，周家老祖毕竟作为四大家族中的领袖人物，他很快就回过神来，对另外三人递了一个眼色，示意他们不要冲动，以免引起不必要的冲突。
然后，他转过头，脸上露出一丝笑容，对着天阴老人说道：“呵呵，天阴老祖，我等这就带路！”
他的语气虽然客气，但其中的无奈和勉强还是显而易见的。
接着，周家老祖又偏过头，对站在一旁的周天雄吩咐道：“天雄，你过会与另外三位族长会合，一起前往李家，可听明白了？”
周天雄因为那道冷意，使得他的心跳依然有些急促。
他努力让自己平静下来，因为老祖的吩咐不容有丝毫耽搁，接着深吸一口气，然后高声回应道：“是！”
周家老祖在得到周天雄的回应后，再次与另外三家老祖对视一眼，彼此之间似乎传递着一种默契和对策。
紧接着，他身形一闪飞身而起，朝着李家的方向疾驰而去。
天阴老人将他们的小动作看在眼里。
但却并没有理会！
content_en:
After that, he turned his head to look at the back mountain and shouted loudly: "Everyone, please come out! Don't let Ancestor Tianyin mistakenly think that we are not ready yet!"
Its sound is like a loud bell, echoing in the mountains.
Before he finished speaking, he saw three figures speeding towards him from the back mountain.
In the blink of an eye, the three figures landed steadily not far from the ancestors of the Zhou family.
When the three people were settled, they were the ancestors of the Yuan family, the Huang family, and the Mo family.
Seeing this, the ancestor of the Zhou family raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing an imperceptible smile.
He paused for a moment, then continued to cast his gaze on Old Man Tianyin, and said slowly: "Ancestor Tianyin, these three are the ancestors of our other three major families on the Beiyuan River.
They learned that you were here today, so they have been waiting here for a long time! "
When Old Man Tianyin heard this, he nodded expressionlessly, which was a response to the introduction of the ancestor of the Zhou family.
However, at this moment, the ancestor of the Wang family, who was standing next to the old man Tianyin, looked at everyone and said, "I, Hengshui Wang Jiuyong, Wang Jieyong of the Wang family, are lucky enough to meet three of you today. I am really lucky in my lifetime!"
After saying that, he specially bowed to the ancestors of the three families, with a kind smile on his face.
Seeing this, the ancestor of the Mo family hurriedly returned the greeting and said: "My Mo family, I have heard about the name of ancestor Wang for a long time. When I meet you today, it is indeed well-deserved!"
Immediately afterwards, the ancestor of the Huang family also raised his hands and said with a smile: "Huang Bahu of the Huang family has met Ancestor Wang!"
Finally, the ancestor of the Yuan family was not to be outdone and said loudly: "Yuan Chongren of the Yuan family, pays homage to Patriarch Wang!"
Then several people exchanged polite greetings.
The old man Tianyin on the side, his face still gloomy, said in a cold and cold voice.
"Now that everything is ready, let's set off!" His words were short and direct, without any sloppiness.
However, this simple sentence revealed a majesty and indifference that could not be ignored.
Regarding the so-called four major families along the Beiyuan River, Old Man Tianyin obviously did not take them seriously at all.
Everyone present except the ancestor of the Wang family who looked as usual and didn't seem to care about old man Tianyin's attitude.
The ancestors of the other four major families looked at each other and could see a hint of displeasure in each other's eyes.
After all, they are also strong men in the innate perfection state, but in front of old man Tianyin, they don't feel the respect they deserve at all.
This feeling of being looked down upon made these four ancestors feel a little uncomfortable.
However, the ancestor of the Zhou family was, after all, the leader of the four major families. He quickly came to his senses and glanced at the other three people, signaling them not to be impulsive, so as not to cause unnecessary conflicts.
Then, he turned his head, with a smile on his face, and said to Old Man Tianyin: "Haha, Ancestor Tianyin, I will lead the way right away!"
Although his tone was polite, the helplessness and reluctance in it were still obvious.
Then, the ancestor of the Zhou family turned his head again and ordered Zhou Tianxiong who was standing aside: "Tianxiong, you will meet the other three clan leaders later and go to the Li family together. Do you understand?"
Zhou Tianxiong's heartbeat was still a little rapid because of that coldness.
He tried to calm himself down, because the ancestor's instructions did not allow for any delay, then took a deep breath, and responded loudly: "Yes!"
After receiving Zhou Tianxiong's response, the ancestor of the Zhou family looked at each other again with the ancestors of the other three families, and there seemed to be a tacit understanding and countermeasures conveyed between them.
Immediately afterwards, he flew up in a flash and galloped towards the Li family.
Old Man Tianyin noticed their little moves.
But he didn’t pay attention!
